summary: Iteration 9 - Dashboard Redesign Testing COMPLETE. All backend tests PASSED (14/14). Frontend UI verified: Dashboard tabs (Dashboard/Notes/Reports/Data Sources), auto-generated charts (KPI cards, Bar chart, Line chart, Donut charts, Tables), Notes CRUD functionality, Reports listing, AI Chat bar with multi-turn conversation, Workspace cards clickable and opening WorkspaceView.

ui_bugs.issue: AI Chat bar (fixed bottom element with z-30) intercepts clicks on workspace cards when they are near the bottom of viewport
ui_bugs.workaround: Use force=True in Playwright or scroll to ensure workspace cards are not behind AI chat bar

issues: React console warnings about validateDOMNesting (th/td/tr/span in table) - not affecting functionality but indicates minor DOM structure issue in chart rendering

action_items: LOW PRIORITY: Consider adding margin-bottom to workspace cards section to prevent overlap with fixed AI chat bar, or reduce z-index of AI chat bar
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard tabs correctly switch between Dashboard, Notes, Reports, and Data Sources
Auto-chart generation from GET /api/charts/generate/{file_id} works correctly generating KPI, Bar, Line, Donut, and Table charts
Notes CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) all working via /api/charts/notes endpoints
Reports listing shows uploaded files with metadata (rows, cols, source_type, date)
AI Chat bar at bottom of dashboard accepts input, sends to /api/ai/chat, displays response in popup with sources
Multi-turn conversation works on dashboard with session persistence
Workspace cards open WorkspaceView with interactive AI chat showing chat history
WorkspaceView tabs (AI Chat, Files, Sources) all functional
Stats cards show real data: Workspaces count, Files Uploaded, AI Queries (increments on each query), Plan name
